<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that converts the target molecule into a carboxylic acid precursor and an amine precursor (amidation). We'll search the template catalog for a reaction that breaks a C‑O bond of a carboxylic acid and forms a C‑N bond to give an amide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
